body_text: In this chapter we develop the foundations of affine schemes. The central construction associates to a commutative ring its prime spectrum, a topological space equipped with a structure sheaf. We assume familiarity with basic commutative algebra throughout this exposition.

body_text: A quasi-coherent sheaf on an affine scheme corresponds to a module over the underlying ring. This equivalence of categories is the cornerstone of the theory and allows algebraic computations to be reinterpreted geometrically.
